items.q: INTERVIEWER: ...It says here... These are Martin Williams' liner notes for the Victor release...

ctx.x: Did they have "Boogie Woogie" and "Mule Face," all them numbers?

Let's see. "Mule Face Blues," yeah. "Don't You Think I Love You, Olga," "Shake It And Break It," "Stingaree Blues" and "Nelson Stomp." Okay, so you were on all of those selections.
